description: All money conditions of a case and the conventions of its report; nothing has a default

accounting.description: The conventions a report cannot be built without

allocation.description: How the cost of a plant that delivers heat and cold is split between them

heat_cost_share.description: Share of the cost charged to the heat, between 0 and 1 (no unit); lcoc gets the rest

gwp.description: The global warming potentials of the CO2-equivalent, and the set they come from

CH4.description: Global warming potential of methane, kg CO2 per kg CH4 (no unit)

standard.description: The name of the set of global warming potentials (text)

capex.description: The capex factor of each equipment kind: the investment per unit of the size the kind is priced by; a kind a plant uses and the economics lacks raises missing_assumption

absorption_chiller.description: Investment in the equipment kind absorption_chiller: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

adsorption_chiller.description: Investment in the equipment kind adsorption_chiller: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

boiler.description: Investment in the equipment kind boiler: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

chp.description: Investment in the equipment kind chp: per W of electric capacity (EUR/W)

circulation_pump.description: Investment in the equipment kind circulation_pump: per W of shaft power at the nominal flow (EUR/W)

compression_chiller.description: Investment in the equipment kind compression_chiller: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

cooler.description: Investment in the equipment kind cooler: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

degasser.description: Investment in the equipment kind degasser: fixed amount (EUR)

drilling.description: Investment in the equipment kind drilling: per metre of well (EUR/m), or a table of the cost per metre by measured depth

electric_boiler.description: Investment in the equipment kind electric_boiler: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

flare.description: Investment in the equipment kind flare: fixed amount (EUR)

gas_makeup.description: Investment in the equipment kind gas_makeup: fixed amount (EUR)

heat_exchanger.description: Investment in the equipment kind heat_exchanger: per W/K of conductance (EUR/(W/K)), or per W of nominal duty (EUR/W); the unit tells the basis

heat_pump.description: Investment in the equipment kind heat_pump: per W of capacity (EUR/W)

ice_storage.description: Investment in the equipment kind ice_storage: per m3 (EUR/m3), or per J of energy capacity (EUR/MWh); the unit tells the basis

injection_pump.description: Investment in the equipment kind injection_pump: per W of shaft power at the nominal flow (EUR/W)

pipe.description: Investment in the equipment kind pipe: per metre (EUR/m)

production_pump.description: Investment in the equipment kind production_pump: per W of shaft power at the nominal flow (EUR/W), or per unit (EUR); the unit tells the basis

thermal_storage.description: Investment in the equipment kind thermal_storage: per m3 (EUR/m3), or per J of energy capacity (EUR/MWh); the unit tells the basis

carbon.description: The price of the CO2-equivalent a plant emits

price.description: Price of a mass of CO2-equivalent emitted, added to the opex (EUR/t, EUR/kg); constant or a series

currency.description: A label of the currency of every amount (text); nothing converts it

discount_rate.description: Real discount rate per year, as a fraction (0.05 is 5 %; no unit)

energy.description: The price of the energy a plant buys

electricity.description: Price of the electricity bought from the grid (EUR/MWh, EUR/kWh); constant or a series

gas.description: Price of the gas bought from the grid, per energy of its lower heating value (EUR/MWh, EUR/kWh); constant or a series. Co-produced gas costs nothing

opex.description: The operating costs besides the energy bought: fixed per kind, and consumables

fixed.description: Fixed operation and maintenance of each equipment kind: a share of its capex per year (%/yr, 1/yr), or, for a kind sized by a power, an amount per capacity and year (EUR/MW/yr, EUR/W/yr: production_pump, injection_pump, circulation_pump, heat_pump, boiler, electric_boiler, chp, absorption_chiller, adsorption_chiller, compression_chiller, heat_exchanger, cooler); the unit tells which. A kind a plant uses and the map lacks raises missing_assumption

variable.description: The consumables priced by the market, per kg; the names accepted are chemical and waste_disposal and no other

chemical.description: Price of the chemical products a plant draws from its ChemicalGrid, per kg of product (EUR/kg, EUR/t): every dosed product, a scale or a corrosion inhibitor of an InhibitorDosing alike; constant or a series

waste_disposal.description: Cost of disposing of the waste a plant sends to its WasteGrid (sand, scale, blowdown), per kg (EUR/kg, EUR/t); constant or a series

price_year.description: The year the prices are in (a whole number, no unit)

revenue.description: What the energy a plant delivers earns, and a subsidy

cold.description: Price of the useful cold delivered (EUR/MWh, EUR/kWh); constant or a series

heat.description: Price of the useful heat delivered (EUR/MWh, EUR/kWh); constant or a series

subsidy.description: A subsidy paid on top of the revenue from the first year; it earns nothing unless both amount and duration are given

amount.description: The subsidy paid per year (EUR/yr, MEUR/yr), or per energy of the useful heat delivered (EUR/MWh), as SDE++ pays; the unit tells which

cap.description: The most heat a year a subsidy per energy is paid on: an energy per year (MWh/yr), or full-load hours per year (h/yr) times the capacity; absent, all the useful heat

capacity.description: The capacity the subsidy is granted for (MW), which a cap in full-load hours multiplies

duration.description: How long the subsidy is paid (yr), within the analysis period

title: Economics
